rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The letters Ṭā and Hā signify the Pure and the Guide.
rows.anchor: الطاء إشارة إلى الطاهر، والهاء إلى الهادي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Out of mercy and love for his people, the Prophet grieved that revelation did not move them to faith and feared a personal shortcoming.
rows.anchor: من شدة حنوه وتعطفه على قومه لكونه صورة الرحمة ومظهر المحبة، تأسف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their disbelief stems from their side: hardened veils and absent receptivity, not the Prophet's ego, residual selfhood, or failure to guide.
rows.anchor: أخبر أن عدم إيمانهم ليس من جهتك بل من جهتهم وغلظ حجابهم أعدم استعدادهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The names Pure and Guide free the Prophet from imputations of residual selfhood or deficient guidance; the Quran is a reminder for receptive, softened hearts after his purification.
rows.anchor: نودي باسمين من أسماء الله تعالى دالين على نزاهته عن الأمرين المذكورين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Spiritual discipline has already produced in the Prophet the two qualities signified by those names, making him perfected and perfecting; hard hearts explain why his guidance has no effect.
rows.anchor: ما المقصود بالرياضة إلا هذان الأمران اللذان ظهرا فيك تجلينا عليك بالاسمين المذكورين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the opening is an oath by the two names disclosed to him for purification and spiritual refinement, not a direct address; revelation's aim is their effect in him, not toil.
rows.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون قسما لا نداء، أي: أقسم بالاسمين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet's family are called the Family of Ṭā Hā because the meanings of the two names have appeared in them.
rows.anchor: بحصول المعنيين لهم وظهور مسمى الاسمين فيهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The revelation descends from the One bearing all majestic and beautiful attributes, so the Prophet's essence must share in all of them to receive and bear it.
rows.anchor: أنزلناه تنزيلا ممن اتصف بجميع الصفات الجمالية والجلالية فكان لذاتك نصيب من جميعها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: An incoming effect must correspond to its source; otherwise the Prophet's essence could not receive and carry the revelation.
rows.anchor: إذ الأثر الوارد لا بد وأن يناسب المورد كما ناسب المصدر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As the heavens and earth veil divine beauty with majesty, the Prophet is veiled by seven layers of unseen spiritual states and perfection, and by the witnessed earth of his body.
rows.anchor: فكما خلق السموات العلا والأرض أي: عالم الأرواح وعالم الأجسام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The emphatic declaration and shift from Lord to God keep Moses from stopping at the divine attributes and names and becoming veiled from the Essence; the Lord is the disclosed name through which guidance comes.
rows.anchor: بالتأكيد، وتبديل الرب بالله لئلا يقف مع الصفات في الحضرة الأسمائية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one God is described by every attribute, yet divine unity and selfhood do not multiply through the many manifestations and attributes.
rows.anchor: لم أتكثر ولم يتعدد أنائيتي وأحديتي بكثرة المظاهر وتعدد الصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worship is directed to the Essence rather than its names and attributes, preparing the annihilation of selfhood in the divine Reality and essential glorification.
rows.anchor: خصص عبادتك بذاتي دون أسمائي وصفاتي بالعبادة الذاتية وتهيئة استعداد فناء الأنية في حقيقتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The commanded prayer is spiritual witnessing of the Essence, above the heart's presence that remembers the attributes.
rows.anchor: صلاة الشهود الروحي لذكر ذاتي فوق صلاة الحضور القلبي لذكر صفاتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Hour is the greater resurrection, complete annihilation in the eye of unity; its concealment through the attributes allows ranks, souls, deeds, and recompense to appear.
rows.anchor: القيامة الكبرى بالفناء المحض في عين الأحدية { آتية أكاد أخفيها } باحتجابي بالصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God discloses the Hour only to chosen individuals one by one, since its full manifestation would annihilate all selves, deeds, reward, and distinction.
rows.anchor: فلا أظهرها إلا لأفراد خواصي واحدا بعد واحد لأني إن أظهرتها ظهر فناء الكل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The object in Moses' right hand signifies his self in the grasp of intellect, the right hand by which a person receives God's gift and restrains the self.
rows.anchor: العقل يمين يأخذ به الإنسان العطاء من الله ويضبط به نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The staff represents reliance on intellect in the visible world, acquiring perfection, journeying to God, and taking on divine traits; these require it.
rows.anchor: أعتمد في عالم الشهادة وكسب الكمال والسير إلى الله والتخلق بأخلاقه عليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses shakes useful sciences and practical wisdom from the tree of spirit by thought, feeding the animal faculties represented by his flock.
rows.anchor: أخبط أوراق العلوم النافعة والحكم العملية من شجرة الروح بحركة الفكر بها على غنم القوى الحيوانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The staff also serves the acquisition of spiritual stations and the pursuit of states, gifts, and disclosures.
rows.anchor: من كسب المقامات وطلب الأحوال والمواهب والتجليات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God asks about the staff to remove the awe caused by the manifestation of majesty and replace it with security.
rows.anchor: وإنما سأله تعالى لإزالة الهيبة الحاصلة له بتجلي العظمة عنه وتبديلها بالأمن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses' answer exceeds the question because of his intense longing for conversation and sustained delight in intimacy.
rows.anchor: وإنما زاد الجواب على السؤال لشدة شغفه بالمكالمة واستدامة ذوق الاستئناس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's command to cast the staff means letting the self go from the control of intellect.
rows.anchor: أي: خلها عن ضبط العقل { فألقاها } أي: خلاها وشأنها مرسلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses released it after it had absorbed lights from manifestations of the divine attributes of severity.
rows.anchor: مرسلة بعد احتظائها من أنوار تجليات صفات القهر الإلهي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The serpent signifies intense anger: Moses had a forceful, sharp-tempered soul, and his preparedness gave him a greater share of the overpowering attribute's manifestation.
rows.anchor: كانت نفسه عليه السلام قوية الغضب، شديدة الحدة، فلما بلغ مقام تجليات الصفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As Moses was annihilated in the attributes, his anger became divine anger and lordly overpowering, taking serpent form and swallowing what it encountered.
rows.anchor: فبدل غضبه عند فنائه في الصفات بالغضب الإلهي والقهر الرباني فصور ثعبانا يتلقف ما يجد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Taking the staff means restoring it to intellectual control as before.
rows.anchor: أي: اضبطها بعقلك كما كانت { ولا تخف } من استيلائها عليك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses need not fear its domination or the variegation of his spiritual state: his anger has vanished, and the anger now moves by God's command, no longer hidden in the soul beneath heart-light.
rows.anchor: فإن غضبك قد فنى، فيكون متحركا بأمري وليس هو مستورا بنور القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Its first state is death and annihilation, reduced to vegetative capacity without awareness or impulse; it was called a staff because Moses' training under Shuʿayb made it like vegetative faculties, and Shuʿayb is said to have given it to him.
rows.anchor: أي: ميتة، فانية، صائرة إلى رتبة القوة النباتية التي لا شعور لها ولا داعية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses asks for certainty and firmness amid the attributes' manifestation so abuse will not constrict or wound him; he hears and sees his persecutors through God, remains patient, and avoids becoming veiled by his own and their attributes.
rows.anchor: بنور اليقين والتمكين في مقام تجلي الصفات لئلا يضيق بإيذائهم، ولا تتأذى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Making the affair easy means enabling the mission's audience to accept God's religion and supplying support against its opponents.
rows.anchor: أي: أمر الدعوة بتوفيقهم لقبول دينك وإمدادي على المعاندين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The knot is in intellect and thought, which impede fluent speech, courage to proclaim the message, and the proof needed to face tyranny.
rows.anchor: من عقد العقل والفكر المانعين عن إطلاق لساني بكلامك والجراءة والشجاعة على تصريح الكلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Understanding comes through God softening the audience's hearts into humility and awe, and aiding Moses from the sacred realm.
rows.anchor: لتليينك قلوبهم والخشوع والخشية فيها وتأييد إياي من عالم القدس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The remaining story does not admit interpretation as allegory; if applied spiritually, Moses is the heart asking that Aaron, its older brother through their father, intellect, be made its minister and counsel-giving helper in attaining perfections.
rows.anchor: وباقي القصة لا يقبل التأويل فإن أردت التطبيق فاعلم أن موسى القلب يسأل الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Glorification means stripping away the soul's traits; remembrance means acquiring knowledge and realities, presence in disclosures, and witnessing the attribute manifestations.
rows.anchor: بالتجريد عن صفات النفس وهيئاتها { ونذكرك } باكتساب المعارف والحقائق والحضور فى المكاشفات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses invokes God's sight of their preparedness and aptitude for perfection, asking for help and cooperation in what God sees and wills.
rows.anchor: فأعنا واجعلنا متعاونين على ما ترى منا وتريد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their refusal reflects the soul's high aspiration, which certainty in the heart produces: worldly fortune, bodily hardship, fleeting pleasure, and sensory pain matter little beside enduring intellectual bliss.
rows.anchor: عظم الهمة الحاصلة للنفس بقوة اليقين، إذ قوة اليقين في القلب تورث النفس عظم الهمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They dismiss Pharaoh's threat because it concerns only the present worldly life.
rows.anchor: استخفوا بها واستحقروها بقولهم: { إنما تقضي هذه الحياة الدنيا }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Forgiveness means covering with divine light the dark forms and blameworthy traits produced by attachment to natural pleasures and worldly adornments.
rows.anchor: يستر بنوره الهيئات المظلمة والصفات الرديئة التي عرضت لنفوسنا بسبب الميل إلى اللذات الطبيعية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The magicians had recognized Moses' truth by their innate preparedness and tried to decline competing with him, but Pharaoh compelled them to perform magic.
rows.anchor: بنور استعدادهم وعلموا كونه على الحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the minor resurrection, a criminal arrives burdened by bodily dispositions that incline toward natural bodies; he neither dies a natural death and feels no pain nor lives truly to escape sin's consequences.
rows.anchor: في القيامة الصغرى مجرما مثقلا بالهيئات البدنية المميلة إلى الأجرام الطبيعية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believer has certain faith and has practiced psychic virtues that purify the soul; the high stations are gardens of attributes corresponding to degrees of spiritual perfection.
rows.anchor: بالإيمان اليقيني { قد عمل الصالحات } من الفضائل النفسانية المزكية للنفوس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The night signifies the darkness of the soul's attributes and corporeality; a dry path through the sea is detachment from the world of prime matter, free of material forms and bodily substances.
rows.anchor: في ظلمة صفات النفوس وليل الجسمانية { فاجعل لهم طريقا } من التجريد في بحر عالم الهيولى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wayfarers need not fear pursuit by bodily people immersed in nature's darkness, who cannot reach them.
rows.anchor: لحوقا من البدنيين المنغمسين في غواشي الطبيعة الظلمانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They need not fear being overpowered because those immersed in nature are confined and incapable of their spiritual rank.
rows.anchor: غلبتهم عليكم واستيلاءهم، فإنهم مقيدون محبوسون فيها، قاصرون عن شأنكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh's pursuit signifies destroying his religion through immersion in natural things; the sea of pitch brought eternal destruction and everlasting torment.
rows.anchor: لإهلاكهم دينهم بالانغماس في الطبيعيات فغشيهم من يم القطران ما غشيهم من الهلاك السرمدي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All existent essences bow to the Living, Sustaining One and are captive to His dominion and power; they live and subsist only through Him.
rows.anchor: وكلها في أسر مملكته وذل قهره وقدرته، لا تحيا ولا تقوم إلا به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wrongdoer who diminished readiness and clouded pure nature loses hope of mercy and intercession, since the darkened face can no longer receive illumination.
rows.anchor: من ظلم نفسه بنقص استعداده وتكدير صفاء فطرته، فزال قبوله للتنور باسوداد وجهه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Through purification and adornment, a person of realized faith need not fear losing acquired perfections or being denied what the original aptitude entails.
rows.anchor: بالتزكية والتحلية { وهو مؤمن } بالإيمان التحقيقي { فلا يخاف } أن ينقص شيء من كمالاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hoped-for result is purification that makes them God-fearing, or adornment that gives them renewed remembrance.
rows.anchor: { لعلهم يتقون } بالتزكية { أو يحدث لهم ذكرا } بالتحلية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's exaltation is beyond estimation; as true King He governs all by will and power in justice, giving each its due according to wisdom.
rows.anchor: تناهى في العلو والعظمة بحيث لا يقدر قدره ولا يغدر أمره في ملكه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses must not rush, from longing for direct knowledge at the station of union, before its arrival is settled; knowledge descends according to the stages of receptivity.
rows.anchor: عند هيجان الشوق لغاية الذوق بتلقي العلم اللدني عن مكمن الجمع { من قبل } أن يحكم بوروده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seeking knowledge has no end: pursue increase through purification, spiritual ascent, and adornment, since readiness rather than premature asking opens each higher and subtler knowledge.
rows.anchor: ولا تفتر عن الطلب والاستفاضة فإنه غير متناه، واطلب الزيادة فيه بزيادة التصفية والترقي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the spiritual realm, opposites do not collide and there is no dissolution leading to corruption; the soul enjoys its desire, safe from extinction.
rows.anchor: في التجرد عن ملابسة المواد في العالم الروحاني لا يمكن تزاحم الأضداد ولا يكون التحليل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Turning toward the lower world through psychic desire constricts livelihood: a stagnant soul clings to material adornments and possessions, and accumulating them intensifies greed and miserliness.
rows.anchor: بالتوجه إلى العالم السفلي بالميل النفسي، ضاقت معيشته لغلبة شحه وشدة بخله

rows.speaker: بعض الصوفية
rows.claim: Some Sufis say that whoever turns from remembrance of the Lord finds life darkened and provision troubled.
rows.anchor: قال بعض الصوفية: لا يعرض أحد عن ذكر ربه إلا أظلم عليه وتشوش عليه رزقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: By contrast, the one who remembers and turns to God lives with certainty and trust, spends what is available, and dispenses with what is absent through reliance on the Lord.
rows.anchor: بخلاف الذاكر المتوجه إليه فإنه ذو يقين منه وتوكل عليه في سعة من عيشه ورغد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The minor resurrection finds the denier blind to divine light, as in 17:72; innate preparedness and natural light still attest to the blindness caused by entrenched lower-world love, bodily transgression, and forgetting signs.
rows.anchor: الصغرى على عماه من نور الحق كقوله: ومن كان في هذه أعمى فهو في الآخرة أعمى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The afterlife's punishment is harsher and more lasting than worldly constriction because it is spiritual and permanent.
rows.anchor: من ضنك العيش في الدنيا لكونه روحانيا دائما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One reading is that heaven and earth were joined from one prime matter and bodily substance, then split by the differentiation of forms.
rows.anchor: مرتوقتين من هيولى واحدة ومادة جسمانية { ففتقناهما } بتباين الصور، أو أن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the heavens of spirits and earth of body were joined as one sperm and divided through the differentiation of limbs and spirits.
rows.anchor: أو أن سموات الأرواح وأرض الجسد كانا مرتوقتين في صورة نطفة واحدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every animal is created from the sperm.
rows.anchor: أي: خلقنا من النطفة كل حيوان { وجعلنا } في أرض الجسد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mountains correspond to bones in the body's earth, keeping it from shaking, shifting, or failing to stand upright.
rows.anchor: العظام كراهة أن تضطرب وتجيء وتذهب وتختلف بهم فلا تقوم بهم وتستقل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The body's pathways are routes for the senses and faculties, through which people may recognize God's signs and know Him.
rows.anchor: مجاري، طرقا للحواس وجميع القوى { لعلهم يهتدون } بتلك الحواس والطرق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sky is the rational faculty, raised above and protected from change, forgetfulness, and error, though people turn away from its arguments and proofs.
rows.anchor: سماء العقل { سقفا } مرتفعا فوقهم { محفوظا } من التغير والسهو والخطأ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Night is the soul and day the intellect, illuminated by the spirit's sun and heart's moon; each travels toward God in a rank and station within the spiritual heavens.
rows.anchor: ليل النفس ونهار العقل الذي هو نور شمس الروح وقمر القلب { كل في فلك } أي: مقر علوي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The soul, root of human creation, is restless and unstable, making people hasty; this enables progress from state to state, while the spirit remains constant and its attachment to the soul yields the balanced heart.
rows.anchor: النفس التي هي أصل الخلقة دائمة الطيش والاضطراب لا تثبت على حال فهو مجبول على العجل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As long as the soul's station predominates over the serenity of spirit and heart, haste remains part of human constitution.
rows.anchor: فما دام الإنسان في مقام النفس ولم يغلب عليه نور الروح والقلب المفيد للسكينة والطمأنينة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The veiled will face encompassing punishment by God's all-knowing command and cannot repel what lies ahead or behind them.
rows.anchor: المحجوبون عن الرحمن العام الفيض وعن المعاد الشامل للكل وقت إحاطة العذاب بهم جميع الجهات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What lies before them is the spirit-facing direction, where the soul suffers divine severity and total deprivation of spiritual lights and human perfections.
rows.anchor: من الجهة التي تلي الروح المعذبة بنار القهر الإلهي والحرمان الكلي من الأنوار الروحانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: What lies behind them is the body's direction, tormented by bodily dispositions, black psychic scorpions and snakes, material filth, and physical pain; their dense veils and doubt leave them without help.
rows.anchor: من الجهة التي تلي الجسد المعذبة بنار الهيئات الجسمانية والعقارب والحيات السود النفسانية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worship and reverence belong to God alone: nothing else benefits or harms, since He is the sole beneficial and harmful agent.
rows.anchor: وتعظمون غيره مما لا ينفع ولا يضر، إذ هو النافع الضار لا غير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rebuke expresses exasperation at the existence of the people, their idols, and everything besides God.
rows.anchor: أتضجر بوجودكم ووجود معبوداتكم ووجود كل ما سواء تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reason should recognize that no agent has effect and none deserves worship except God.
rows.anchor: أن لا مؤثر ولا معبود إلا الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fish-bearing one signifies a spirit that has not reached perfection.
rows.anchor: أي: الروح الغير الواصل إلى رتبة الكمال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His departure signifies separation from the body, while his anger is directed at psychic faculties veiled from him and stubbornly refusing and resisting him.
rows.anchor: بالمفارقة عن البدنية { مغاضبا } عن قومه، القوى النفسانية لاحتجابها وإصرارها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase may mean that he thought God would not exercise power over him through a trial like his, or that God would not constrict him.
rows.anchor: أي: لن نستعمل قدرتنا فيه بالابتلاء بمثل ما ابتلي به، أو: لن نضيق عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fish of mercy swallowed him because divine wisdom required his attachment to a body for use and service.
rows.anchor: فالتقمه حوت الرحمة لوجوب تعلقه بالبدن في حكمتنا للاستعمال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He called from the three darknesses of bodily nature, vegetative soul, and animal soul, speaking through innate preparedness.
rows.anchor: في ظلمات المراتب الثلاث من الطبيعة الجسمانية والنفس النباتية والحيوانية بلسان الاستعداد

words: أن لا إله إلا أنت سبحانك
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He confessed the essential unity imprinted in him by the prior covenant and natural pledge, and declared God's transcendence through the first primordial detachment.
rows.anchor: فأقر بالتوحيد الذاتي المركوز فيه عند العهد السابق وميثاق الفطرة والتنزيه المستفاد من التجرد الأول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He admitted his deficiency and failure to exercise justice with his people; God answered by enabling his wayfaring, giving patient guidance, and rescuing him from veiling through theophany.
rows.anchor: واعترف بنقصانه وعدم استعمال العدالة في قومه فقال: { إني كنت من الظالمين فاستجبنا له } بالتوفيق بالسلوك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God similarly saves believers whose faith is realized and certain.
rows.anchor: { وكذلك ننجي المؤمنين } بالإيمان التحقيقي الموقنين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At the minor resurrection the soul's sky, containing forms of deeds and dispositions, is folded like a written page so its contents remain preserved.
rows.anchor: سماء النفس بما فيها من صور الأعمال وهيئات الأخلاق في الصغرى { كطي } الصحيفة للمكتوبات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, at the intermediate resurrection it is the heart's sky and its knowledge, attributes, cognitions, and intelligibles that are folded.
rows.anchor: أو سماء القلب بما فيها من العلوم والصفات والمعارف والمعقولات في الوسطى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, at the major resurrection the spirit's sky, with knowledge from visions and disclosures, is folded.
rows.anchor: أو سماء الروح بما فيها من العلوم من المشاهدات والتجليات في الكبرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The return can mean resurrection in a second creation, return to primordial nature at the middle level, or subsistence after annihilation at the highest level.
rows.anchor: بالبعث في النشأة الثانية على الأول أو بالرجوع إلى الفطرة الأولى على الثاني أو بالبقاء بعد الفناء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One reading is that the heart's Psalter records, after the Preserved Tablet, the body's earth being inherited by righteous, illuminated faculties once vicious powers are destroyed by discipline.
rows.anchor: زبور القلب { من بعد الذكر } في اللوح أن أرض البدن يرثها القوى الصالحة المنورة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the Preserved Tablet after the Mother Book records the earth inherited by spirit, secret, heart, intellect, soul, and all faculties through uprightness after their annihilation in unity.
rows.anchor: أو: ولقد كتبنا في زبور اللوح المحفوظ من بعد الذكر في أم الكتاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This is sufficient and a great mercy for wayfarers: mercy guides them to absolute perfection and protects them from annihilating punishment, since mercy prevails over wrath.
rows.anchor: لكفاية { لقوم } عبدوا الله بالسلوك فيه { رحمة } عظيمة مشتملة على الرحيمية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Removing ritual excess symbolizes removing residual psychic traits: trimming the mustache signifies curbing eagerness, clipping nails curbs anger and rancor, and the general aim is to end the soul's fluctuations.
rows.anchor: وسخ الفضول وفضلات ألواث الهيئات كقص شارب الحرص، وقلم أظفار الغضب والحقد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fulfilling vows means actualizing the meanings and perfections deposited in people and accepted in the first covenant; purifying removes obstacles, while fulfilling vows adorns and acquires knowledge.
rows.anchor: بالقيام بإبراز ما قبلوه في العهد الأول من المعاني والكمالات المودعة فيهم إلى الفعل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Circumambulation signifies joining the highest kingdom around God's glorious throne, the ancient house.
rows.anchor: بالانخراط في سلك الملكوت الأعلى حول عرش الله المجيد البيت القديم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's sacred rites include what must not be violated, self-offering and purification, and the spiritual practices of virtue, avoiding vice, receiving disclosures, adopting divine attributes, and ascending stations.
rows.anchor: وهي مالا يحل هتكه وتطهيره والقربان بالنفس وجميع ما ذكر من المناسك كالتحلي بالفضائل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Honoring these sacred things benefits the wayfarer in God's presence and the station of nearness.
rows.anchor: في حضرة ربه ومقعد قربه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The lawful cattle are sound souls whose moral qualities and deeds may be used along the path, enjoying their rights rather than personal interests.
rows.anchor: أنعام النفوس السليمة بالانتفاع بأخلاقها وأعمالها في الطريقة والتمتع بالحقوق دون الحظوظ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The forbidden exceptions are vices that masquerade as virtues: acts issuing from the soul in an improper way, prohibited to spiritual wayfarers.
rows.anchor: في صورة المائدة من الرذائل المشتبهة بالفضائل وهي التي صدرت من النفس لا على وجهها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Idols signify enslaving desires and followed whims, as in 45:23.
rows.anchor: أوثان الشهوات المتعبدة؛ والأهواء المتبعة، كقوله تعالى: أفرأيت من اتخذ إلهه هواه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: False speech signifies embellished sciences and specious doubts built from imaginings and suppositions for disputation and sophistry.
rows.anchor: من العلوم المزخرفة والشبهات المموهة من التخيلات والموهومات، المستعملة في الجدل والخلاف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The believers who succeed in the greatest victory are those certain of faith.
rows.anchor: دخل في الفوز الأعظم الموقنون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Humility is the heart's presence in prayer, overcome by awe and reverence at the manifestation of majesty's light.
rows.anchor: في صلاة حضور القلب { خاشعون } باستيلاء الخشية والهيبة عليهم لتجلي نور العظمة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Turning away from idle excess follows from being occupied with the Real.
rows.anchor: أي: الفضول { معرضون } لاشتغالهم بالحق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their zakat is detachment from their own traits.
rows.anchor: { والذين هم للزكاة فاعلون } بالتجرد عن صفاتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Guarding private parts means abandoning the causes of pleasures and desires, leaving personal interests for rightful claims; those who seek desires beyond that wrong themselves.
rows.anchor: وأسباب لذاتهم وشهواتهم { حافظون } بترك الحظوظ والاقتصار على الحقوق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The trusts are secrets God deposited in their innermost selves; the covenant is God's pledge at the beginning of primordial nature, to be fulfilled and brought to life.
rows.anchor: من أسراره التي أودعهم الله إياها في سرهم { وعهدهم } الذي عاهدهم الله عليه في بدء الفطرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Preserving prayer means witnessing the spirits; those with these traits inherit Firdaws, the spirit's garden in the sacred enclosure.
rows.anchor: صلاة مشاهدة أرواحهم { يحافظون } { أولئك } الموصوفون بهذه الصفات { هم الوارثون }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Truth means unity and justice, the call to Essence and attributes; following the desires of plural, veiled souls would destroy justice sustaining heaven and earth and unity sustaining immaterial realities.
rows.anchor: الذي هو التوحيد والعدل، أي الدعوة إلى الذات والصفات { أهواءهم } المتفرقة في الباطل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Unity preserves the realities of things, while its shadow, justice and the ordering of multiplicity, sustains heaven and earth; losing both would corrupt all.
rows.anchor: إذ بالوحدة بقاء حقائق الأشياء، وبظلها الذي هو العدل ونظام الكثرات قوام الأرض والسماء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The straight path is unity, bringing justice to the soul, love to the heart, and witnessing of unity to the spirit; those veiled by sensation, impurity, and multiplicity are steeped in injustice and hostility and veer away from it.
rows.anchor: طريق التوحيد المستلزم لحصول العدالة في النفس ووجود المحبة في القلب وشهود الوحدة في الروح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The houses are spiritual stations in which God guides whom He wills to His light.
rows.anchor: أي: يهدي الله لنوره من يشاء في مقامات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The stations are raised through God's permission, with their ranks elevated.
rows.anchor: أن يرفع بناؤها وتعلى درجاتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Remembrance progresses through the stations: tongue and struggle and moral formation in the soul, presence and vigilance in the heart, secret-realization and witnessing, spirit's bewilderment in lights, then absorption and annihilation in the Essence.
rows.anchor: باللسان والمجاهدة والتخلق بالأخلاق في مقام النفس والحضور والمراقبة، والاتصاف بالأوصاف في مقام القلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their glorification is purification, transcendence, unity, detachment, and individuation, through dawn's disclosure and evening's concealment.
rows.anchor: بالتزكية والتنزيه والتوحيد والتجريد والتفريد بغدو التجلي وآصال الاستتار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The men are singular spiritual exemplars: advanced, detached and individuated, established in the Real.
rows.anchor: أي: رجال أفراد سابقون مجردون مفردون قائمون بالحق

words: لا تلهيهم تجارة ولا بيع عن ذكر الله
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their commerce does not trade the afterlife for this world through asceticism, and their sale is of selves and wealth for promised paradise in spiritual struggle; neither distracts from remembrance of the Essence.
rows.anchor: باستبدال متاع العقبى بالدنيا في زهدهم، ولا بيع أنفسهم وأموالهم بأن لهم الجنة في جهادهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prayer is witnessing in annihilation, while zakat is guidance and spiritual completion during subsistence.
rows.anchor: صلاة الشهود في الفناء { وإيتاء } زكاة الإرشاد والتكميل حال البقاء

words: يخافون يوما تتقلب فيه القلوب والأبصار
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hearts turn toward secrets and eyes toward inner perceptions; their realities are annihilated and made existent through the Real, as in the report that God becomes the servant's hearing and sight.
rows.anchor: إلى الأسرار { والأبصار } إلى البصائر، بل تتقلب حقائقها بأن تفنى وتوجد بالحق، كما قال: " كنت سمعه وبصره "

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God rewards them with real existence and gardens of deeds and selves, then increases them from the gardens of hearts and attributes.
rows.anchor: بالوجود الحقاني { أحسن ما عملوا } من جنات الأفعال والنفوس والأعمال { ويزيدهم من فضله }

words: والله يرزق من يشاء بغير حساب
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He grants the gardens of spirits and visions without measure because they exceed what can be counted or compared.
rows.anchor: من جنات الأرواح والمشاهدات { بغير حساب } لكونه أكثر من أن يحصى ويقاس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God subdues the heavens and earth beneath His dominion.
rows.anchor: يقهرهما تحت ملكوته، أوجد كل شيء موسوما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Everything He brings into being bears the mark of contingency and testifies to its nonexistence in itself.
rows.anchor: أوجد كل شيء موسوما، يتعين بسمة الإمكان، ويشهد عليه بالعدم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He apportions each thing according to its capacity to receive some attributes and manifest some perfections, preparing each aptitude for the perfections He wills.
rows.anchor: على قدر قبول بعض صفاته ومظهرية بعض كمالاته دون بعض، أي: هيأ استعداداتهم لما شاء
